description: Trinkwasser-Prioritätenprogramm 2017 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. On the basis of the annual amendments and new applications from water suppliers and drinking water protection cooperations, the list of the Nds Priority Programme for Drinking Water Protection (PP-TWS) is published. Ministry of Environment, Energy and Climate Protection. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water priority programme 2017" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
